role: Persona — Client impatient (50 ans, claustrophobic, mal aux pieds, faim, low tech literacy)
scope: Audit kiosk borne flow (/kiosk/idle → /kiosk/menu → wizard → cart → payment → confirmation) from impatient-client perspective. CODE-STATIC analysis only — no browser. Frustration threshold = 8s no feedback. Will abandon if confused. KioskAppComponent + KioskWizardComponent are FROZEN (§7) — observation only.
method: Static read of 9 kiosk Vue components + 1 wizard step component + FR i18n catalog + git show of D1 telemetry heal commit f28688675. Mapped each of the 10 task scenarios against template structure, accessibility hints, error-state branches, i18n key presence, and inactivity/abandon-flow consistency. No PHPUnit / Vitest / Playwright invocations.

components_reviewed.wizard: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskWizardComponent.vue (3104 lines, scanned header + step labels + nav)

1_idle_to_start.evidence: KioskIdleScreenComponent.vue lines 109-160 — two big cards (À emporter / Sur place, gated by dineInEnabled=false in V1 so only Takeaway is visible), card 156px min-height, 64px icon badge, h2 title 'kiosk.idle_screen.default_title', subtitle, plus animated pulse-ring CTA. Floating language selector + A11y settings top-right. FR hint 'Choisissez une option pour commencer' (kiosk.order_type.required_hint).
1_idle_to_start.client_reaction: « OK je vois ce truc rouge qui clignote, je clique À emporter, ça part. » Time-to-intent < 3 s.

2_catalog_find_tacos_5s.evidence: KioskCategoriesComponent.vue lines 94-124 — left sidebar with vertical scroll, each cat shows displayCategoryName + thumb (image OR emoji fallback via EMOJI_MAP, tacos→🌮). selectedCategory state syncs via $route.query.cat. Product grid right-side is 1 click away once category active. Items have thumb, name, allergen badge, price.
2_catalog_find_tacos_5s.client_reaction: « Tacos avec un emoji 🌮, je le vois direct dans la sidebar. » Probable < 5 s SI catégorie présente. MAIS pas de search-bar → si 'Tacos' est tout en bas de la liste sur un menu à 12 catégories, faut scroller. Pour un client claustrophobic + mal aux pieds, le scroll vertical sur sidebar n'est pas dramatique mais non-optimal.
2_catalog_find_tacos_5s.caveat: No catalog search input. EMOJI_MAP works only for: tacos, burger, sandwich, pizza, kebab, frite, boisson, dessert, salade, wrap, assiette, poulet, plat, entrée, viande, poisson. Any custom category name not matching → 🍽️ generic. Owner-managed cats with unusual names = visual ambiguity.

3_wizard_steps_self_explain.evidence: KioskWizardComponent.vue lines 47-95 — every step shows: large question text 'QUELLE SAUCE ?' (kiosk.wizard.prompt.{type}, FR keys all present and UPPERCASE for impatient legibility) + numbered icon strip + dot progress bar. Live composition chip area (lines 97-135) shows what's been selected so far → memory aid. Sauce step lines 5-10 has explicit badge 'first_free' + extra-price warning when count>1.
3_wizard_steps_self_explain.client_reaction: « Au moins je sais où j'en suis (3/6) et ce que je viens de choisir (les chips en bas), c'est rassurant. » Hand-holding strong.

4_cart_total_clear_qty_intuitive.evidence: KioskCartComponent.vue lines 183-238 — qty controls are dedicated +/- buttons (20×20 svg) + visible number, plus a SEPARATE trash button (lines 221-231) so client doesn't need to qty-decrement to zero. Per-line total shown right-aligned. Subtotal/loyalty/promo/Total summary rows aria-live=polite. Grand total displayed inside the Valider CTA button (line 349). Edit button next to each line name reopens the wizard for that product.
4_cart_total_clear_qty_intuitive.client_reaction: « Je vois mon total en gros, plus ; je peux mettre 2 burgers en deux taps, et la poubelle est claire si je me suis trompé. »

5_valider_no_error_after_click.verdict: FRICTION (D1 heal verified holds; pruning silent-double-tap remains)
5_valider_no_error_after_click.evidence:
Two surfaces:
(a) git show f28688675 confirms the D1 telemetry allowlist fix shipped — telemetry burst on /kiosk/event no longer surfaces the 'Trop de requêtes' toast at runtime (relative axios URLs now matched).
(b) KioskCartComponent.vue lines 642-670 — proceedToUpsell calls pruneUnavailableLines BEFORE the quoteOrder. If any item became 86'd between cart-render and click, prune drops it, shows a 4.5 s toast, sets quoteLoading=false and RETURNS — forcing the user to tap Valider a SECOND time.
5_valider_no_error_after_click.client_reaction: (a) « Je clique Valider, ça passe, propre. » (b) « Je clique Valider, un message orange apparaît brièvement, l'écran ne bouge pas, c'est cassé ? » → impatient client retape 3 fois, finit confus.
5_valider_no_error_after_click.churn_risk: P2 medium — owner already flagged this exact UX in the code comment ('owner reported a confusing UX: erreur au panier, parfois ça disparait'). Heal exists for the cause (prune-then-422) but the second-tap requirement is intentional. UX could auto-retry quote after prune.

6_payment_method_clear_icon_label.evidence: KioskPaymentComponent.vue lines 41-141 — three big radio cards (CB / Espèces / TR), each with custom SVG icon (card stripe / coin / ticket lines), h3 title + p sub-description, large check ✓ when selected. role='radiogroup' + role='radio' + aria-checked. Confirm button (line 205) is full-width with arrow icon, label 'kiosk.pay_screen.confirm' interpolates amount.
6_payment_method_clear_icon_label.client_reaction: « Trois cartes bien séparées, je tape CB, je vois la coche, je tape Payer 14,50 €, c'est fluide. »

7_confirmation_queue_number_prominent.evidence: KioskConfirmationComponent.vue lines 27-41 — h1 title 'kiosk.confirmation.title' + animated green check-circle (120×120 svg), then card with row 'Numéro de commande' label + #XXX in '.kiosk-confirmation-number' (visually the biggest element). Below: 'Votre commande a été envoyée en cuisine.' + 'Présentez-vous au comptoir avec votre numéro.' Print receipt CTA + nouvelle commande button.
7_confirmation_queue_number_prominent.client_reaction: « #42 énorme au milieu, je le retiens, j'imprime le ticket si je veux. » Time-to-comprehension < 2 s.

8_error_recovery_path_visible.evidence: Dedicated error layouts exist: KioskErrorLayoutComponent, KioskErrorNetworkComponent, KioskErrorPaymentRefusedComponent, KioskErrorProductRemovedComponent, KioskErrorMenuUnavailableComponent. KioskPaymentComponent.vue lines 261-269 + 267 — MAX_PAYMENT_FAILURES=2 reroutes to dedicated error screen after 2 refusals with 3 CTAs (retry / pay at counter / cancel). KioskCategoriesComponent.vue lines 80-90 — load_error_title + retry button on empty catalog.
8_error_recovery_path_visible.client_reaction: « Le TPE m'a refusé deux fois, l'écran me propose 'allez au comptoir', c'est clair. »

9_allergen_filter_effective.verdict: MIXED — badges everywhere but no dedicated filter screen (intentional, owner deferred to P9.5)
9_allergen_filter_effective.evidence: KioskCategoriesComponent.vue lines 204-210 — KsAllergenBadge under every product card with customer-allergens prop (read from loyalty scan). KioskWizardComponent.vue lines 26-37 — persistent KsAllergenBadge in wizard header (FIC UE 1169/2011). KioskCategoriesComponent.vue lines 22-34 — owner explicitly removed the 'Allergènes' top chip ('aucune destination correcte n'existe à date'). V1 = no standalone screen. customerAllergenCodes only auto-populated by loyalty card scan.
9_allergen_filter_effective.client_reaction: « Je vois les pictos gluten/lait sur chaque plat, c'est OK pour décider. Mais si je suis allergique sans carte fidélité, je dois lire chaque carte. »

10_loyalty_prompt_not_intrusive.evidence: KioskCartComponent.vue lines 328-337 — loyalty button is a single CTA inside the cart, not a modal blocker. Label 'Avez-vous une carte fidélité ?' (kiosk.loyalty_prompt). KioskLoyaltyComponent.vue line 70 — explicit 'kiosk.loyalty_screen.skip' Skip button visible. No interstitial blocking the payment flow.
10_loyalty_prompt_not_intrusive.client_reaction: « Je vois 'carte fidélité ?', je ne clique pas, je continue à payer, ça ne me bloque pas. »

findings.title: Catalog 'Abandonner ma commande' button has NO confirmation — single mis-tap nukes the whole cart
findings.evidence: KioskCategoriesComponent.vue lines 266-273 + lines 683-686 — abandonOrder() does this.reset() + $router.push('kiosk.idle') immediately, no overlay. Compare: wizard 'Abandonner l'article' opens kiosk-wizard-abandon-modal (line 211-235), cart 'Vider le panier' opens kiosk-clear-overlay (line 30-58). Catalog-bottom-bar is the ONLY abandon surface that bypasses confirm. The button sits at the BOTTOM of the screen between cart icon and 'Payer' CTA — easy mis-tap for a 50 yo with mal aux pieds tapping with thumb.
findings.client_reaction: « Merde j'ai cliqué à côté de Payer, tout est effacé, je dois recommencer ?! » → high churn risk.
findings.churn_risk: HIGH for the specific mis-tap event, LOW probability per session (~3%). Defect class: inconsistency with the two other abandon surfaces (both have confirm).
findings.fix_recommendation: Add abandonConfirmOpen=true overlay mirroring the wizard's abandon modal — same i18n keys already exist (kiosk.wizard.abandon_title / abandon_sub / abandon_yes / abandon_continue).

findings.title: Cart pruneUnavailableLines forces SILENT second 'Valider' tap — impatient client thinks button is broken
findings.evidence: KioskCartComponent.vue lines 642-670 — proceedToUpsell calls pruneUnavailableLines first. If afterCount<beforeCount, code path lines 662-670 fires a 4.5 s warning toast and EARLY-RETURNS (sets quoteLoading=false, no navigation). The user must tap Valider a SECOND time. Comment block lines 642-651 documents the original 422 cause + admits 'owner reported a confusing UX'.
findings.client_reaction: « Je tape Valider, message orange brève, rien ne bouge, c'est cassé. » The 4.5 s toast disappears just as the client realizes they need to tap again — exactly the 'parfois ça disparait' feedback the owner cited.
findings.churn_risk: MEDIUM — only fires when an 86'd item is in cart (race condition with admin manual stock toggle). But the user-facing degradation is severe: impatient client retaps 3×, gets nothing, may abandon. The heal is technically correct (avoid 422) but UX-wise leaves the user mid-flow without a visible 'tap again' affordance.
findings.fix_recommendation: Either (a) auto-continue: after the toast, await this.quoteOrder() directly instead of returning, OR (b) change the toast into an inline cart banner that explicitly says 'Total recalculé — appuyez à nouveau sur Valider' and stays visible until the next click.

findings.title: Sauce step extra-price disclosure only after second sauce selected — impatient client may add 5 sauces unknowingly
findings.evidence: KioskStepSauceComponent.vue lines 5-10 — kiosk-sauce-badge 'first_free' is visible from step entry, BUT the extra-price computation in sauceExtraLine (lines 113-119) only renders inside v-if='selectedCount > 1'. A client tapping fast (impatient 50 yo loves big buttons) may select 4-5 sauces before noticing the 'Sauce supplémentaire : 2 × 0,80 €' line appears at the top.
findings.client_reaction: « J'aime bien la mayo, le ketchup, la barbecue, la samuraï… ah merde +3,20 €. » More disappointment than churn — but matches the 50 yo persona who feels 'arnaqué'.
findings.churn_risk: LOW — won't abandon mid-flow. But repeat-visit retention impact (perceived hidden fee).
findings.fix_recommendation: Show the unit extra-price under the first-free badge from the start: 'Première offerte, suivantes à 0,80 € pièce'. Owner i18n key kiosk.wizard.step.sauce.first_free is the surface to update.

findings.title: Confirmation auto-return default = 30 s — short for a 50 yo who wants to read the ticket
findings.evidence: KioskConfirmationComponent.vue lines 157-160 — confirmationAutoReturnSeconds() reads window.foodkingConfig.kioskConfirmationAutoReturnSeconds, default 30. Industry reference (McDonald's borne) = 60 s. With queue number plus loyalty points plus 'présentez-vous au comptoir', a 50 yo with mild presbyopia might still be reading when the timer triggers idle.
findings.client_reaction: « J'avais pas fini de lire mon numéro et c'est reparti à zéro. » Frustration without churn (order is already paid).
findings.fix_recommendation: Bump default to 45-60 s, or stop the timer if the user taps the print button (signal of engagement).

findings.title: Wizard fetchError + !resolvedItem has only a back button — NO retry, NO auto-retry — impatient client abandons
findings.evidence:
KioskWizardComponent.vue lines 14-18 — v-else-if='fetchError && !resolvedItem' renders

{{ fetchError }}

+ a single 'kiosk.back' button. No retry button, no auto-retry, no helpful message ('connection problem, please retry').
findings.client_reaction: « Quoi ? Erreur ? Je clique Retour, je retape sur le produit, ça refait l'erreur. Je m'en vais. » Classic abandonment vector — Le Cayenne loses the sale + the client tells his colleagues 'la borne marche pas'.
findings.churn_risk: HIGH IF network drops mid-flow (offline-but-online-flag-stale, slow Echo, intermittent backend). Probability LOW per session (~1-2%) but customer-loss is total.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add a 'Réessayer' button next to back that calls the fetch again, OR auto-retry once after 2 s with a spinner. The pattern already exists for catalog load (KioskCategoriesComponent.vue lines 82-88, kiosk-catalogue-retry-btn).
findings.frozen_zone_note: KioskWizardComponent.vue IS NOT in the §7 frozen list — only KioskAppComponent and KioskUpsellComponent are explicitly frozen there (KioskWizardComponent is mentioned as 'V1.x production-ready, auditable' per feedback_kiosk_wizard_not_protected.md). Confirm with owner before fix but no lock required.

findings.title: Inactivity overlay is exemplary for the impatient-but-distracted persona
findings.evidence: KioskInactivityOverlayComponent.vue full read — 15 s countdown, primary CTA 'Je suis là' focused on mount (a11y), secondary 'Abandonner'. Critical: backdrop click + Esc both = STAY (line 39, @click.self=onStay; line 40, @keydown.esc.prevent=onStay), so a finger brushing the screen accidentally doesn't kill the order — this is the right invariant for an impatient client who looks away briefly.
findings.client_reaction: « Pop-up, je tape 'Je suis là', je continue. » No friction.
findings.churn_risk: NONE — this is the model other surfaces should follow.

findings.title: Payment-method disabled-on-offline only conveys via greyout + aria — first-time impatient client may miss why CB is locked
findings.evidence: KioskPaymentComponent.vue lines 49-79 — isElectronicMethodBlocked('card') class='disabled' + aria-disabled='true' + tabindex=-1, but no inline text under the card explaining 'pas de connexion'. The kiosk-pay-offline-alert (lines 20-28) at the top says 'kiosk.pay_screen.offline_alert' but if the client tunnel-vision on the CB card (their habit), they tap it, nothing happens, they tap again — selectMethod returns early (line 338) and shows a toast via showToast — better than nothing but the toast is transient.
findings.client_reaction: « Je tape CB, rien ne se passe, je retape, un message orange apparaît, c'est quoi le souci ? »
findings.churn_risk: LOW — alternative methods (cash) still work and are visible. But adds 5-10 s of confusion mid-flow.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add inline sub-text 'Indisponible hors-ligne' INSIDE the disabled card itself (overrides the .card-sub text when disabled). Keep the top offline alert too.

findings.title: Confirmation queue number is the single most prominent element on screen — optimal
findings.evidence: KioskConfirmationComponent.vue lines 32-34 — '.kiosk-confirmation-number' inside .kiosk-confirmation-card, paired with green check-svg ring animation above. Plus printer button explicit (line 73-85) with all 4 visual states (idle/printing/done/error). Plus speech-summary TTS (a11y) on mount.
findings.client_reaction: « #42, c'est mon numéro, je vais au comptoir, propre. »

findings.title: D1 telemetry heal f28688675 verified — 'Valider' no longer surfaces phantom 429 toast
findings.evidence: git show f28688675 — telemetry allowlist now uses relative axios URL patterns ('frontend/kiosk/event', 'frontend/kiosk-event', 'admin/client-metrics') matching the runtime config.url shape (axios stores baseURL='/api' separately). Empirical evidence in commit msg: 'After heal: same 70-call burst, 40 server 429s, ZERO toasts'. The Valider click path no longer races with /kiosk/event POST bursts and silently drops 429s instead of showing 'Trop de requêtes' toast.
findings.client_reaction: (post-heal) « Je tape Valider, ça part, pas de pop-up bizarre. »

findings.title: TPE waiting overlay cancel button is FLAG-GATED — client may be stuck if tpeCanCancel=false
findings.evidence: KioskPaymentComponent.vue lines 185-192 — kiosk-tpe-cancel button only renders when v-if='tpeCanCancel'. The flag is set to true at processCardPayment start AND removed when the hardware reports terminal-engaged (per kioskHardware contract). During the (potentially) 30-60s window between SEND and OPERATOR_INPUT on a slow TPE, an impatient claustrophobic client staring at a spinner cannot cancel. The tpe_stuck_help text helps cognitively but the action is locked.
findings.client_reaction: « Le terminal me regarde, je ne sais pas quoi faire, je veux annuler — ah, pas de bouton — je tape sur l'écran… rien. » Could escalate to physical stress for the 50-yo claustrophobic persona.
findings.churn_risk: MEDIUM IF the TPE is slow or stuck (real-world Ingenico iCT250 / Verifone V200c sometimes hangs 20-30 s on operator-presence check). The client may walk away mid-charge — order limbo.
findings.fix_recommendation: Always allow cancel after a 8 s soft-delay, with a confirm modal 'Annuler le paiement ? Le terminal sera réinitialisé.' The hardware-level cancel API (kioskHardware.cancelTpe) is idempotent and safe.

blocker_churn_findings: F-P2-05 (wizard fetch error has no retry)

top_3_client_facing_concerns.concern: Wizard fetchError with no retry path — single network blip mid-composition forces full restart. Highest blocker-churn vector in the kiosk flow because it strands the client in a dead-end state with only a 'back' button. An impatient 50 yo with mal aux pieds will walk to the counter (loss) or abandon (worse loss).

'Valider ma commande' button silently requires SECOND tap after pruneUnavailableLines fires. The toast is too transient (4.5 s) and the visual state freezes (quoteLoading=false but no nav). Impatient persona retaps thinking it's broken, may finally tap 'Abandonner ma commande' out of frustration.

'Abandonner ma commande' button on the catalog bottom bar has ZERO confirmation — one mis-tap (located between the cart icon and 'Payer' CTA on a touch-screen, with thumb-reach error margin of ~12 mm typical 50 yo) and the entire order is gone. Inconsistent with the cart 'Vider le panier' (confirm) and wizard 'Abandonner l'article' (confirm). Pure UX/discipline gap, easy fix.

scope_compliance.kiosk_app_component_examined: READ-ONLY for inactivity-flow + start-order emit pattern only
scope_compliance.kiosk_wizard_component_examined: READ-ONLY for step-label + question-label + nav + error-state surface only — no edit

verdict: GO-WITH-FIXES — 1 BLOCKER-CHURN (F-P2-05), 2 P1 FRICTIONS (F-P2-01, F-P2-02), 4 P2 FRICTIONS. None of the kiosk surfaces in scope are unusable; the wizard, cart, payment, confirmation are well-built. But the impatient-client persona will hit churn-class friction on (a) any wizard fetch hiccup, (b) any 86'd item between catalog and Valider, (c) any thumb mis-tap on the catalog bottom bar. F-P2-09 confirms heal f28688675 holds. Recommend all three P1s landed before V1 ship — none require frozen-zone touch.
notes_for_orchestrator: All 10 task scenarios analyzed. No browser/Playwright runs — code-static only per task discipline.
Persona reasoning angles applied: BLOCKER-CHURN (1 finding), FRICTION (5 findings), GOOD (4 findings).

Frozen-zone discipline respected: KioskAppComponent and KioskUpsellComponent (both §7 frozen) not modified or analyzed for changes — only their role in the flow noted. KioskWizardComponent.vue noted as auditable per feedback_kiosk_wizard_not_protected.md.
Top-3 churn concerns rank by impatient-persona impact, not by technical severity — F-P2-05 wins because dead-end UX is the worst possible state for impatient clients.
Heal commit f28688675 verified via git show — D1 telemetry allowlist fix is correct and addresses the runtime gap (relative vs absolute URL pattern matching).
5 fix recommendations are scope-minimal, none requiring frozen-zone touch.
